prompt: Build one row of a multiplication table as a String like "3 6 9 12" -- single spaces between numbers and no trailing space. Complete the multiplicationRow method.
explanation: This is a classic fencepost problem: 4 numbers need only 3 separators, so appending "number + space" every time leaves a trailing space. Appending the space BEFORE every number except the first solves it cleanly -- the if (i > 1) guard skips the very first separator. A StringBuilder avoids creating a new String on every loop iteration, which is the idiomatic way to build strings in a loop.
hints: Loop i from 1 to upTo and append n * i each time.
The trailing-space trap: k numbers need only k - 1 separators. Decide where the space goes.
Append the separator before each number except the first (guard it with if (i > 1)), and use a StringBuilder.
